<h1 id="content-api-for-shopping">Content API for Shopping v2</h1>

* <a href="https://shoppingcontent.googleapis.com/content/v2">https://shoppingcontent.googleapis.com/content/v2</a>

# Authentication

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 implicit authentication

    - Flow: implicit
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content|Manage your product listings and accounts for Google Shopping|

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 authorizationCode authentication

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)
    - Token URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content|Manage your product listings and accounts for Google Shopping|

## content.accounts.custombatch

<a id="opIdcontent.accounts.custombatch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/accounts/batch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "entries": [
      {
        "account": {
          "adultContent": true,
          "adwordsLinks": [
            {
              "adwordsId": "string",
              "status": "string"
            }
          ],
          "businessInformation": {
            "address": {
              "country": "string",
              "locality": "string",
              "postalCode": "string",
              "region": "string",
              "streetAddress": "string"
            },
            "customerService": {
              "email": "string",
              "phoneNumber": "string",
              "url": "string"
            },
            "koreanBusinessRegistrationNumber": "string",
            "phoneNumber": "string"
          },
          "googleMyBusinessLink": {
            "gmbEmail": "string",
            "status": "string"
          },
          "id": "string",
          "kind": "string",
          "name": "string",
          "reviewsUrl": "string",
          "sellerId": "string",
          "users": [
            {
              "admin": true,
              "emailAddress": "string",
              "orderManager": true,
              "paymentsAnalyst": true,
              "paymentsManager": true
            }
          ],
          "websiteUrl": "string",
          "youtubeChannelLinks": [
            {
              "channelId": "string",
              "status": "string"
            }
          ]
        },
        "accountId": "string",
        "batchId": 0,
        "force": true,
        "labelIds": [
          "string"
        ],
        "linkRequest": {
          "action": "string",
          "linkType": "string",
          "linkedAccountId": "string"
        },
        "merchantId": "string",
        "method": "string",
        "overwrite": true
      }
    ]
  }'
```

|» businessInformation|body|[AccountBusinessInformation](#schemaaccountbusinessinformation)|false|The business information of the account.|
|» googleMyBusinessLink|body|[AccountGoogleMyBusinessLink](#schemaaccountgooglemybusinesslink)|false|The GMB account which is linked or in the process of being linked with the Merchant Center account.|
|» id|body|string(uint64)|false|Required for update. Merchant Center account ID.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#account`"|
|» name|body|string|false|Required. Display name for the account.|
|» reviewsUrl|body|string|false|[DEPRECATED] This field is never returned and will be ignored if provided.|
|» sellerId|body|string|false|Client-specific, locally-unique, internal ID for the child account.|
|» users|body|[[AccountUser](#schemaaccountuser)]|false|Users with access to the account. Every account (except for subaccounts) must have at least one admin user.|
|» websiteUrl|body|string|false|The merchant's website.|
|» youtubeChannelLinks|body|[[AccountYouTubeChannelLink](#schemaaccountyoutubechannellink)]|false|List of linked YouTube channels that are active or pending approval. To create a new link request, add a new link with status `active` to the list. It will remain in a `pending` state until approved or rejected in the YT Creator Studio interface. `POST /{merchantId}/orderinvoices/{orderId}/createRefundInvoice`

Creates a refund invoice for one or more shipment groups, and triggers a refund for orderinvoice enabled orders. This can only be used for line items that have previously been charged using `createChargeInvoice`. All amounts (except for the summary) are incremental with respect to the previous invoice.

## content.orders.list

<a id="opIdcontent.orders.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/string/orders \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /{merchantId}/orders`

Lists the orders in your Merchant Center account.

<h3 id="contentorderslist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|merchantId|path|string|true|The ID of the account that manages the order. This cannot be a multi-client account.|
|acknowledged|query|boolean|false|Obtains orders that match the acknowledgement status. When set to true, obtains orders that have been acknowledged. When false, obtains orders that have not been acknowledged. We recommend using this filter set to `false`, in conjunction with the `acknowledge` call, such that only un-acknowledged orders are returned. |
|maxResults|query|integer|false|The maximum number of orders to return in the response, used for paging. The default value is 25 orders per page, and the maximum allowed value is 250 orders per page.|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Order results by placement date in descending or ascending order. Acceptable values are: - placedDateAsc - placedDateDesc |
|pageToken|query|string|false|The token returned by the previous request.|
|placedDateEnd|query|string|false|Obtains orders placed before this date (exclusively), in ISO 8601 format.|
|placedDateStart|query|string|false|Obtains orders placed after this date (inclusively), in ISO 8601 format.|
|statuses|query|[string]|false|Obtains orders that match any of the specified statuses. Please note that `active` is a shortcut for `pendingShipment` and `partiallyShipped`, and `completed` is a shortcut for `shipped`, `partiallyDelivered`, `delivered`, `partiallyReturned`, `returned`, and `canceled`.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

`POST /{merchantId}/orders/{orderId}/inStoreRefundLineItem`

Deprecated. Notifies that item return and refund was handled directly by merchant outside of Google payments processing (e.g. cash refund done in store). Note: We recommend calling the returnrefundlineitem method to refund in-store returns. We will issue the refund directly to the customer. This helps to prevent possible differences arising between merchant and Google transaction records. We also recommend having the point of sale system communicate with Google to ensure that customers do not receive a double refund by first refunding via Google then via an in-store return.

> Body parameter

```json
{

    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "amountTax": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
```

`POST /{merchantId}/orders/{orderId}/returnRefundLineItem`

Returns and refunds a line item. Note that this method can only be called on fully shipped orders. Please also note that the Orderreturns API is the preferred way to handle returns after you receive a return from a customer. You can use Orderreturns.list or Orderreturns.get to search for the return, and then use Orderreturns.processreturn to issue the refund. If the return cannot be found, then we recommend using this API to issue a refund.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amountPretax": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "amountTax": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "lineItemId": "string",
  "operationId": "string",
  "productId": "string",
  "quantity": 0,
  "reason": "string",
  "reasonText": "string"
}
```

## content.products.list

<a id="opIdcontent.products.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/string/products \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /{merchantId}/products`

Lists the products in your Merchant Center account. The response might contain fewer items than specified by maxResults. Rely on nextPageToken to determine if there are more items to be requested.

<h3 id="contentproductslist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|merchantId|path|string|true|The ID of the account that contains the products. This account cannot be a multi-client account.|
|includeInvalidInsertedItems|query|boolean|false|Flag to include the invalid inserted items in the result of the list request. By default the invalid items are not shown (the default value is false).|
|maxResults|query|integer|false|The maximum number of products to return in the response, used for paging.|
|pageToken|query|string|false|The token returned by the previous request.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

|» adwordsLabels|body|[string]|false|Similar to adwords_grouping, but only works on CPC.|
|» adwordsRedirect|body|string|false|Allows advertisers to override the item URL when the product is shown within the context of Product Ads.|
|» ageGroup|body|string|false|Target age group of the item. Acceptable values are: - "`adult`" - "`infant`" - "`kids`" - "`newborn`" - "`toddler`" - "`youngAdult`" |
|» aspects|body|[[ProductAspect](#schemaproductaspect)]|false|Deprecated. Do not use.|
|» availability|body|string|false|Availability status of the item. Acceptable values are: - "`in stock`" - "`out of stock`" - "`preorder`" |
|» availabilityDate|body|string|false|The day a pre-ordered product becomes available for delivery, in ISO 8601 format.|
|» brand|body|string|false|Brand of the item.|
|» canonicalLink|body|string|false|URL for the canonical version of your item's landing page.|
|» channel|body|string|false|Required. The item's channel (online or local). Acceptable values are: - "`local`" - "`online`" |
|» color|body|string|false|Color of the item.|
|» condition|body|string|false|Condition or state of the item. Acceptable values are: - "`new`" - "`refurbished`" - "`used`" |
|» contentLanguage|body|string|false|Required. The two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the item.|
|» costOfGoodsSold|body|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|Cost of goods sold. Used for gross profit reporting.|
|» customAttributes|body|[[CustomAttribute](#schemacustomattribute)]|false|A list of custom (merchant-provided) attributes. It can also be used for submitting any attribute of the feed specification in its generic form (e.g., `{ "name": "size type", "value": "regular" }`). This is useful for submitting attributes not explicitly exposed by the API, such as additional attributes used for Buy on Google (formerly known as Shopping Actions).|
|» customGroups|body|[[CustomGroup](#schemacustomgroup)]|false|A list of custom (merchant-provided) custom attribute groups.|
|» customLabel0|body|string|false|Custom label 0 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel1|body|string|false|Custom label 1 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel2|body|string|false|Custom label 2 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel3|body|string|false|Custom label 3 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel4|body|string|false|Custom label 4 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the item.|
|» destinations|body|[[ProductDestination](#schemaproductdestination)]|false|Specifies the intended destinations for the product.|
|» displayAdsId|body|string|false|An identifier for an item for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» displayAdsLink|body|string|false|URL directly to your item's landing page for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» displayAdsSimilarIds|body|[string]|false|Advertiser-specified recommendations.|
|» displayAdsTitle|body|string|false|Title of an item for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» displayAdsValue|body|number(double)|false|Offer margin for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» energyEfficiencyClass|body|string|false|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU. Acceptable values are: - "`A`" - "`A+`" - "`A++`" - "`A+++`" - "`B`" - "`C`" - "`D`" - "`E`" - "`F`" - "`G`" |
|» expirationDate|body|string|false|Date on which the item should expire, as specified upon insertion, in ISO 8601 format. The actual expiration date in Google Shopping is exposed in `productstatuses` as `googleExpirationDate` and might be earlier if `expirationDate` is too far in the future.|
|» gender|body|string|false|Target gender of the item. Acceptable values are: - "`female`" - "`male`" - "`unisex`" |
|» googleProductCategory|body|string|false|Google's category of the item (see [Google product taxonomy](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/1705911)). When querying products, this field will contain the user provided value. There is currently no way to get back the auto assigned google product categories through the API.|
|» gtin|body|string|false|Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) of the item.|
|» id|body|string|false|The REST ID of the product. Content API methods that operate on products take this as their `productId` parameter. The REST ID for a product is of the form channel:contentLanguage: targetCountry: offerId.|
|» identifierExists|body|boolean|false|False when the item does not have unique product identifiers appropriate to its category, such as GTIN, MPN, and brand. Required according to the Unique Product Identifier Rules for all target countries except for Canada.|
|» imageLink|body|string|false|URL of an image of the item.|
|» installment|body|[Installment](#schemainstallment)|false|Number and amount of installments to pay for an item.|
|» isBundle|body|boolean|false|Whether the item is a merchant-defined bundle. A bundle is a custom grouping of different products sold by a merchant for a single price.|
|» itemGroupId|body|string|false|Shared identifier for all variants of the same product.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#product`"|
|» link|body|string|false|URL directly linking to your item's page on your website.|
|» loyaltyPoints|body|[LoyaltyPoints](#schemaloyaltypoints)|false|Loyalty points that users receive after purchasing the item. Japan only.|
|» material|body|string|false|The material of which the item is made.|
|» maxEnergyEfficiencyClass|body|string|false|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU. Acceptable values are: - "`A`" - "`A+`" - "`A++`" - "`A+++`" - "`B`" - "`C`" - "`D`" - "`E`" - "`F`" - "`G`" |
|» maxHandlingTime|body|string(int64)|false|Maximal product handling time (in business days).|
|» minEnergyEfficiencyClass|body|string|false|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU. Acceptable values are: - "`A`" - "`A+`" - "`A++`" - "`A+++`" - "`B`" - "`C`" - "`D`" - "`E`" - "`F`" - "`G`" |
|» minHandlingTime|body|string(int64)|false|Minimal product handling time (in business days).|
|» mobileLink|body|string|false|URL for the mobile-optimized version of your item's landing page.|
|» mpn|body|string|false|Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the item.|
|» multipack|body|string(int64)|false|The number of identical products in a merchant-defined multipack.|
|» offerId|body|string|false|Required. A unique identifier for the item. Leading and trailing whitespaces are stripped and multiple whitespaces are replaced by a single whitespace upon submission. Only valid unicode characters are accepted. See the products feed specification for details. *Note:* Content API methods that operate on products take the REST ID of the product, *not* this identifier.|
|» onlineOnly|body|boolean|false|Deprecated.|
|» pattern|body|string|false|The item's pattern (e.g. polka dots).|
|» price|body|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|Price of the item.|
|» productType|body|string|false|Your category of the item (formatted as in products data specification).|
|» promotionIds|body|[string]|false|The unique ID of a promotion.|
|» salePrice|body|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|Advertised sale price of the item.|
|» salePriceEffectiveDate|body|string|false|Date range during which the item is on sale (see products data specification ).|

|» shippingWeight|body|[ProductShippingWeight](#schemaproductshippingweight)|false|Weight of the item for shipping.|
|» shippingWidth|body|[ProductShippingDimension](#schemaproductshippingdimension)|false|Width of the item for shipping.|
|» sizeSystem|body|string|false|System in which the size is specified. Recommended for apparel items. Acceptable values are: - "`AU`" - "`BR`" - "`CN`" - "`DE`" - "`EU`" - "`FR`" - "`IT`" - "`JP`" - "`MEX`" - "`UK`" - "`US`" |
|» sizeType|body|string|false|The cut of the item. Recommended for apparel items. Acceptable values are: - "`big and tall`" - "`maternity`" - "`oversize`" - "`petite`" - "`plus`" - "`regular`" |
|» sizes|body|[string]|false|Size of the item. Only one value is allowed. For variants with different sizes, insert a separate product for each size with the same `itemGroupId` value (see size definition).|
|» source|body|string|false|The source of the offer, i.e., how the offer was created. Acceptable values are: - "`api`" - "`crawl`" - "`feed`" |
|» targetCountry|body|string|false|Required. The CLDR territory code for the item.|
|» taxes|body|[[ProductTax](#schemaproducttax)]|false|Tax information.|
|» title|body|string|false|Title of the item.|

|» unitPricingMeasure|body|[ProductUnitPricingMeasure](#schemaproductunitpricingmeasure)|false|The measure and dimension of an item.|
|» validatedDestinations|body|[string]|false|Deprecated. The read-only list of intended destinations which passed validation.|
|» warnings|body|[[Error](#schemaerror)]|false|Read-only warnings.|

## content.products.get

Account data. After the creation of a new account it may take a few minutes before it is fully operational. The methods delete, insert, and update require the admin role.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|adultContent|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the merchant sells adult content.|
|adwordsLinks|[[AccountAdwordsLink](#schemaaccountadwordslink)]|false|none|List of linked AdWords accounts that are active or pending approval. To create a new link request, add a new link with status `active` to the list. It will remain in a `pending` state until approved or rejected either in the AdWords interface or through the AdWords API. To delete an active link, or to cancel a link request, remove it from the list.|
|businessInformation|[AccountBusinessInformation](#schemaaccountbusinessinformation)|false|none|The business information of the account.|
|googleMyBusinessLink|[AccountGoogleMyBusinessLink](#schemaaccountgooglemybusinesslink)|false|none|The GMB account which is linked or in the process of being linked with the Merchant Center account.|
|id|string(uint64)|false|none|Required for update. Merchant Center account ID.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#account`"|
|name|string|false|none|Required. Display name for the account.|
|reviewsUrl|string|false|none|[DEPRECATED] This field is never returned and will be ignored if provided.|
|sellerId|string|false|none|Client-specific, locally-unique, internal ID for the child account.|
|users|[[AccountUser](#schemaaccountuser)]|false|none|Users with access to the account. Every account (except for subaccounts) must have at least one admin user.|
|websiteUrl|string|false|none|The merchant's website.|
|youtubeChannelLinks|[[AccountYouTubeChannelLink](#schemaaccountyoutubechannellink)]|false|none|List of linked YouTube channels that are active or pending approval. To create a new link request, add a new link with status `active` to the list. It will remain in a `pending` state until approved or rejected in the YT Creator Studio interface. To delete an active link, or to cancel a link request, remove it from the list.|

```json
  "status": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|adwordsId|string(uint64)|false|none|Customer ID of the AdWords account.|
|status|string|false|none|Status of the link between this Merchant Center account and the AdWords account. Upon retrieval, it represents the actual status of the link and can be either `active` if it was approved in Google AdWords or `pending` if it's pending approval. Upon insertion, it represents the *intended* status of the link. Re-uploading a link with status `active` when it's still pending or with status `pending` when it's already active will have no effect: the status will remain unchanged. Re-uploading a link with deprecated status `inactive` is equivalent to not submitting the link at all and will delete the link if it was active or cancel the link request if it was pending. Acceptable values are: - "`active`" - "`pending`" |

```json
}
```

The required fields vary based on the frequency of fetching. For a monthly fetch schedule, day_of_month and hour are required. For a weekly fetch schedule, weekday and hour are required. For a daily fetch schedule, only hour is required.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|dayOfMonth|integer(uint32)|false|none|The day of the month the feed file should be fetched (1-31).|
|fetchUrl|string|false|none|The URL where the feed file can be fetched. Google Merchant Center will support automatic scheduled uploads using the HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, or SFTP protocols, so the value will need to be a valid link using one of those four protocols.|
|hour|integer(uint32)|false|none|The hour of the day the feed file should be fetched (0-23).|
|minuteOfHour|integer(uint32)|false|none|The minute of the hour the feed file should be fetched (0-59). Read-only.|
|password|string|false|none|An optional password for fetch_url.|
|paused|boolean|false|none|Whether the scheduled fetch is paused or not.|
|timeZone|string|false|none|Time zone used for schedule. UTC by default. E.g., "America/Los_Angeles".|
|username|string|false|none|An optional user name for fetch_url.|
|weekday|string|false|none|The day of the week the feed file should be fetched. Acceptable values are: - "`monday`" - "`tuesday`" - "`wednesday`" - "`thursday`" - "`friday`" - "`saturday`" - "`sunday`" |

|method|string|false|none|The method of the batch entry. Acceptable values are: - "`get`" |

<h2 id="tocS_DeliveryTime">DeliveryTime</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadeliverytime"></a>
<a id="schema_DeliveryTime"></a>
<a id="tocSdeliverytime"></a>
<a id="tocsdeliverytime"></a>

```json
{
  "cutoffTime": {
    "hour": 0,
    "minute": 0,
    "timezone": "string"
  },
  "handlingBusinessDayConfig": {
    "businessDays": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "holidayCutoffs": [
    {
      "deadlineDate": "string",
      "deadlineHour": 0,
      "deadlineTimezone": "string",
      "holidayId": "string",
      "visibleFromDate": "string"
    }
  ],
  "maxHandlingTimeInDays": 0,
  "maxTransitTimeInDays": 0,
  "minHandlingTimeInDays": 0,
  "minTransitTimeInDays": 0,
  "transitBusinessDayConfig": {
    "businessDays": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "transitTimeTable": {
    "postalCodeGroupNames": [
      "string"
    ],
    "rows": [
      {
        "values": [
          {
            "maxTransitTimeInDays": 0,
            "minTransitTimeInDays": 0
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "transitTimeLabels": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "warehouseBasedDeliveryTimes": [
    {
      "carrier": "string",
      "carrierService": "string",
      "originAdministrativeArea": "string",
      "originCity": "string",
      "originCountry": "string",
      "originPostalCode": "string",
      "originStreetAddress": "string",
      "warehouseName": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cutoffTime|[CutoffTime](#schemacutofftime)|false|none|Business days cutoff time definition. If not configured the cutoff time will be defaulted to 8AM PST.|
|handlingBusinessDayConfig|[BusinessDayConfig](#schemabusinessdayconfig)|false|none|The business days during which orders can be handled. If not provided, Monday to Friday business days will be assumed.|
|holidayCutoffs|[[HolidayCutoff](#schemaholidaycutoff)]|false|none|Holiday cutoff definitions. If configured, they specify order cutoff times for holiday-specific shipping.|
|maxHandlingTimeInDays|integer(uint32)|false|none|Maximum number of business days spent before an order is shipped. 0 means same day shipped, 1 means next day shipped. Must be greater than or equal to `minHandlingTimeInDays`.|
|maxTransitTimeInDays|integer(uint32)|false|none|Maximum number of business days that is spent in transit. 0 means same day delivery, 1 means next day delivery. Must be greater than or equal to `minTransitTimeInDays`.|
|minHandlingTimeInDays|integer(uint32)|false|none|Minimum number of business days spent before an order is shipped. 0 means same day shipped, 1 means next day shipped.|
|minTransitTimeInDays|integer(uint32)|false|none|Minimum number of business days that is spent in transit. 0 means same day delivery, 1 means next day delivery. Either `{min,max}TransitTimeInDays` or `transitTimeTable` must be set, but not both.|
|transitBusinessDayConfig|[BusinessDayConfig](#schemabusinessdayconfig)|false|none|The business days during which orders can be in-transit. If not provided, Monday to Friday business days will be assumed.|
|transitTimeTable|[TransitTable](#schematransittable)|false|none|Transit time table, number of business days spent in transit based on row and column dimensions. Either `{min,max}TransitTimeInDays` or `transitTimeTable` can be set, but not both.|
|warehouseBasedDeliveryTimes|[[WarehouseBasedDeliveryTime](#schemawarehousebaseddeliverytime)]|false|none|Indicates that the delivery time should be calculated per warehouse (shipping origin location) based on the settings of the selected carrier. When set, no other transit time related field in DeliveryTime should be set.|

<h2 id="tocS_Headers">Headers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaheaders"></a>
<a id="schema_Headers"></a>
<a id="tocSheaders"></a>
<a id="tocsheaders"></a>

```json
{
  "locations": [
    {
      "locationIds": [
        "string"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "numberOfItems": [
    "string"
  ],
  "postalCodeGroupNames": [
    "string"
  ],
  "prices": [
    {
      "currency": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "weights": [
    {
      "unit": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

A non-empty list of row or column headers for a table. Exactly one of `prices`, `weights`, `numItems`, `postalCodeGroupNames`, or `location` must be set.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|locations|[[LocationIdSet](#schemalocationidset)]|false|none|A list of location ID sets. Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|numberOfItems|[string]|false|none|A list of inclusive number of items upper bounds. The last value can be `"infinity"`. For example `["10", "50", "infinity"]` represents the headers "<= 10 items", "<= 50 items", and "> 50 items". Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|postalCodeGroupNames|[string]|false|none|A list of postal group names. The last value can be `"all other locations"`. Example: `["zone 1", "zone 2", "all other locations"]`. The referred postal code groups must match the delivery country of the service. Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|prices|[[Price](#schemaprice)]|false|none|A list of inclusive order price upper bounds. The last price's value can be `"infinity"`. For example `[{"value": "10", "currency": "USD"}, {"value": "500", "currency": "USD"}, {"value": "infinity", "currency": "USD"}]` represents the headers "<= $10", "<= $500", and "> $500". All prices within a service must have the same currency. Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|weights|[[Weight](#schemaweight)]|false|none|A list of inclusive order weight upper bounds. The last weight's value can be `"infinity"`. For example `[{"value": "10", "unit": "kg"}, {"value": "50", "unit": "kg"}, {"value": "infinity", "unit": "kg"}]` represents the headers "<= 10kg", "<= 50kg", and "> 50kg". All weights within a service must have the same unit. Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|

<h2 id="tocS_HolidayCutoff">HolidayCutoff</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaholidaycutoff"></a>
<a id="schema_HolidayCutoff"></a>
<a id="tocSholidaycutoff"></a>
<a id="tocsholidaycutoff"></a>

```json
{
  "deadlineDate": "string",
  "deadlineHour": 0,
  "deadlineTimezone": "string",
  "holidayId": "string",
  "visibleFromDate": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|deadlineDate|string|false|none|Date of the order deadline, in ISO 8601 format. E.g. "2016-11-29" for 29th November 2016. Required.|
|deadlineHour|integer(uint32)|false|none|Hour of the day on the deadline date until which the order has to be placed to qualify for the delivery guarantee. Possible values are: 0 (midnight), 1, ..., 12 (noon), 13, ..., 23. Required.|
|deadlineTimezone|string|false|none|Timezone identifier for the deadline hour. A list of identifiers can be found in the AdWords API documentation. E.g. "Europe/Zurich". Required.|
|holidayId|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the holiday. Required.|
|visibleFromDate|string|false|none|Date on which the deadline will become visible to consumers in ISO 8601 format. E.g. "2016-10-31" for 31st October 2016. Required.|

<h2 id="tocS_HolidaysHoliday">HolidaysHoliday</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaholidaysholiday"></a>
<a id="schema_HolidaysHoliday"></a>
<a id="tocSholidaysholiday"></a>
<a id="tocsholidaysholiday"></a>

```json
{
  "countryCode": "string",
  "date": "string",
  "deliveryGuaranteeDate": "string",
  "deliveryGuaranteeHour": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "type": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|countryCode|string|false|none|The CLDR territory code of the country in which the holiday is available. E.g. "US", "DE", "GB". A holiday cutoff can only be configured in a shipping settings service with matching delivery country. Always present.|
|date|string|false|none|Date of the holiday, in ISO 8601 format. E.g. "2016-12-25" for Christmas 2016. Always present.|
|deliveryGuaranteeDate|string|false|none|Date on which the order has to arrive at the customer's, in ISO 8601 format. E.g. "2016-12-24" for 24th December 2016. Always present.|
|deliveryGuaranteeHour|string(uint64)|false|none|Hour of the day in the delivery location's timezone on the guaranteed delivery date by which the order has to arrive at the customer's. Possible values are: 0 (midnight), 1, ..., 12 (noon), 13, ..., 23. Always present.|
|id|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the holiday to be used when configuring holiday cutoffs. Always present.|
|type|string|false|none|The holiday type. Always present. Acceptable values are: - "`Christmas`" - "`Easter`" - "`Father's Day`" - "`Halloween`" - "`Independence Day (USA)`" - "`Mother's Day`" - "`Thanksgiving`" - "`Valentine's Day`" |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|acknowledged|boolean|false|none|Whether the order was acknowledged.|

|deliveryDetails|[OrderDeliveryDetails](#schemaorderdeliverydetails)|false|none|Delivery details for shipments of type `delivery`.|
|id|string|false|none|The REST ID of the order. Globally unique.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#order`"|
|lineItems|[[OrderLineItem](#schemaorderlineitem)]|false|none|Line items that are ordered.|
|merchantId|string(uint64)|false|none|none|
|merchantOrderId|string|false|none|Merchant-provided ID of the order.|
|netAmount|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The net amount for the order. For example, if an order was originally for a grand total of $100 and a refund was issued for $20, the net amount will be $80.|
|paymentMethod|[OrderPaymentMethod](#schemaorderpaymentmethod)|false|none|The details of the payment method.|
|paymentStatus|string|false|none|The status of the payment. Acceptable values are: - "`paymentCaptured`" - "`paymentRejected`" - "`paymentSecured`" - "`pendingAuthorization`" |
|pickupDetails|[OrderPickupDetails](#schemaorderpickupdetails)|false|none|Pickup details for shipments of type `pickup`.|
|placedDate|string|false|none|The date when the order was placed, in ISO 8601 format.|
|promotions|[[OrderLegacyPromotion](#schemaorderlegacypromotion)]|false|none|The details of the merchant provided promotions applied to the order. To determine which promotions apply to which products, check the `Promotions[].Benefits[].OfferIds` field against the `LineItems[].Product.OfferId` field for each promotion. If a promotion is applied to more than 1 `offerId`, divide the discount value by the number of affected offers to determine how much discount to apply to each `offerId`. Examples: 1. To calculate the line item level discount for a single specific item: For each promotion, subtract the `Promotions[].Benefits[].Discount.value` amount from the `LineItems[].Price.value`. 2. To calculate the line item level discount for multiple quantity of a specific item: For each promotion, divide the `Promotions[].Benefits[].Discount.value` by the quantity of products and substract it from `LineItems[].Product.Price.value` for each quantity item. Only 1 promotion can be applied to an offerId in a given order. To refund an item which had a promotion applied to it, make sure to refund the amount after first subtracting the promotion discount from the item price. More details about the program are here.|
|refunds|[[OrderRefund](#schemaorderrefund)]|false|none|Refunds for the order.|
|shipments|[[OrderShipment](#schemaordershipment)]|false|none|Shipments of the order.|
|shippingCost|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The total cost of shipping for all items.|
|shippingCostTax|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The tax for the total shipping cost.|
|shippingOption|string|false|none|Deprecated. Shipping details are provided with line items instead. Acceptable values are: - "`economy`" - "`expedited`" - "`oneDay`" - "`sameDay`" - "`standard`" - "`twoDay`" |

|taxCollector|string|false|none|The party responsible for collecting and remitting taxes. Acceptable values are: - "`marketplaceFacilitator`" - "`merchant`" |

```json
    }
```

```json
  },
```

```json
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|carrier|string|false|none|The carrier handling the shipment. For supported carriers, Google includes the carrier name and tracking URL in emails to customers. For select supported carriers, Google also automatically updates the shipment status based on the provided shipment ID. *Note:* You can also use unsupported carriers, but emails to customers will not include the carrier name or tracking URL, and there will be no automatic order status updates. Supported carriers for US are: - "`ups`" (United Parcel Service) *automatic status updates* - "`usps`" (United States Postal Service) *automatic status updates* - "`fedex`" (FedEx) *automatic status updates * - "`dhl`" (DHL eCommerce) *automatic status updates* (US only) - "`ontrac`" (OnTrac) *automatic status updates * - "`dhl express`" (DHL Express) - "`deliv`" (Deliv) - "`dynamex`" (TForce) - "`lasership`" (LaserShip) - "`mpx`" (Military Parcel Xpress) - "`uds`" (United Delivery Service) - "`efw`" (Estes Forwarding Worldwide) - "`jd logistics`" (JD Logistics) - "`yunexpress`" (YunExpress) - "`china post`" (China Post) - "`china ems`" (China Post Express Mail Service) - "`singapore post`" (Singapore Post) - "`pos malaysia`" (Pos Malaysia) - "`postnl`" (PostNL) - "`ptt`" (PTT Turkish Post) - "`eub`" (ePacket) - "`chukou1`" (Chukou1 Logistics) - "`bestex`" (Best Express) - "`canada post`" (Canada Post) - "`purolator`" (Purolator) - "`canpar`" (Canpar) - "`india post`" (India Post) - "`blue dart`" (Blue Dart) - "`delhivery`" (Delhivery) - "`dtdc`" (DTDC) - "`tpc india`" (TPC India) Supported carriers for FR are: - "`la poste`" (La Poste) *automatic status updates * - "`colissimo`" (Colissimo by La Poste) *automatic status updates* - "`ups`" (United Parcel Service) *automatic status updates * - "`chronopost`" (Chronopost by La Poste) - "`gls`" (General Logistics Systems France) - "`dpd`" (DPD Group by GeoPost) - "`bpost`" (Belgian Post Group) - "`colis prive`" (Colis Privé) - "`boxtal`" (Boxtal) - "`geodis`" (GEODIS) - "`tnt`" (TNT) - "`db schenker`" (DB Schenker) - "`aramex`" (Aramex) |
|creationDate|string|false|none|Date on which the shipment has been created, in ISO 8601 format.|
|deliveryDate|string|false|none|Date on which the shipment has been delivered, in ISO 8601 format. Present only if `status` is `delivered`|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the shipment.|
|lineItems|[[OrderShipmentLineItemShipment](#schemaordershipmentlineitemshipment)]|false|none|The line items that are shipped.|
|scheduledDeliveryDetails|[OrderShipmentScheduledDeliveryDetails](#schemaordershipmentscheduleddeliverydetails)|false|none|Delivery details of the shipment if scheduling is needed.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the shipment. Acceptable values are: - "`delivered`" - "`readyForPickup`" - "`shipped`" - "`undeliverable`" |
|trackingId|string|false|none|The tracking ID for the shipment.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Deprecated. Please use amountPretax and amountTax instead.|
|amountPretax|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Amount to refund for the cancelation. Optional. If not set, Google will calculate the default based on the price and tax of the items involved. The amount must not be larger than the net amount left on the order.|
|amountTax|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Tax amount that corresponds to cancellation amount in amountPretax. Optional, but if filled, then amountPretax must be set. Calculated automatically if not provided.|
|lineItemId|string|false|none|The ID of the line item to cancel. Either lineItemId or productId is required.|
|operationId|string|false|none|The ID of the operation. Unique across all operations for a given order.|
|productId|string|false|none|The ID of the product to cancel. This is the REST ID used in the products service. Either lineItemId or productId is required.|
|quantity|integer(uint32)|false|none|The quantity to cancel.|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason for the cancellation. Acceptable values are: - "`customerInitiatedCancel`" - "`invalidCoupon`" - "`malformedShippingAddress`" - "`noInventory`" - "`other`" - "`priceError`" - "`shippingPriceError`" - "`taxError`" - "`undeliverableShippingAddress`" - "`unsupportedPoBoxAddress`" |
|reasonText|string|false|none|The explanation of the reason.|

|amountPretax|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Amount to refund for the cancelation. Optional. If not set, Google will calculate the default based on the price and tax of the items involved. The amount must not be larger than the net amount left on the order.|
|amountTax|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Tax amount that corresponds to cancellation amount in amountPretax. Optional, but if filled, then amountPretax must be set. Calculated automatically if not provided.|
|lineItemId|string|false|none|The ID of the line item to cancel. Either lineItemId or productId is required.|
|productId|string|false|none|The ID of the product to cancel. This is the REST ID used in the products service. Either lineItemId or productId is required.|
|quantity|integer(uint32)|false|none|The quantity to cancel.|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason for the cancellation. Acceptable values are: - "`customerInitiatedCancel`" - "`invalidCoupon`" - "`malformedShippingAddress`" - "`noInventory`" - "`other`" - "`priceError`" - "`shippingPriceError`" - "`taxError`" - "`undeliverableShippingAddress`" - "`unsupportedPoBoxAddress`" |
|reasonText|string|false|none|The explanation of the reason.|

|reason|string|false|none|The reason for the return. |reasonText|string|false|none|The explanation of the reason.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|postalCodeRangeBegin|string|false|none|A postal code or a pattern of the form `prefix*` denoting the inclusive lower bound of the range defining the area. Examples values: `"94108"`, `"9410*"`, `"9*"`. Required.|
|postalCodeRangeEnd|string|false|none|A postal code or a pattern of the form `prefix*` denoting the inclusive upper bound of the range defining the area. It must have the same length as `postalCodeRangeBegin`: if `postalCodeRangeBegin` is a postal code then `postalCodeRangeEnd` must be a postal code too; if `postalCodeRangeBegin` is a pattern then `postalCodeRangeEnd` must be a pattern with the same prefix length. Optional: if not set, then the area is defined as being all the postal codes matching `postalCodeRangeBegin`.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|adult|boolean|false|none|Should be set to true if the item is targeted towards adults.|
|adwordsGrouping|string|false|none|Used to group items in an arbitrary way. Only for CPA%, discouraged otherwise.|
|adwordsLabels|[string]|false|none|Similar to adwords_grouping, but only works on CPC.|
|adwordsRedirect|string|false|none|Allows advertisers to override the item URL when the product is shown within the context of Product Ads.|
|ageGroup|string|false|none|Target age group of the item. Acceptable values are: - "`adult`" - "`infant`" - "`kids`" - "`newborn`" - "`toddler`" - "`youngAdult`" |
|aspects|[[ProductAspect](#schemaproductaspect)]|false|none|Deprecated. Do not use.|
|availability|string|false|none|Availability status of the item. Acceptable values are: - "`in stock`" - "`out of stock`" - "`preorder`" |
|availabilityDate|string|false|none|The day a pre-ordered product becomes available for delivery, in ISO 8601 format.|
|brand|string|false|none|Brand of the item.|
|canonicalLink|string|false|none|URL for the canonical version of your item's landing page.|
|channel|string|false|none|Required. The item's channel (online or local). Acceptable values are: - "`local`" - "`online`" |
|color|string|false|none|Color of the item.|

|expirationDate|string|false|none|Date on which the item should expire, as specified upon insertion, in ISO 8601 format. The actual expiration date in Google Shopping is exposed in `productstatuses` as `googleExpirationDate` and might be earlier if `expirationDate` is too far in the future.|
|gender|string|false|none|Target gender of the item. Acceptable values are: - "`female`" - "`male`" - "`unisex`" |
|googleProductCategory|string|false|none|Google's category of the item (see [Google product taxonomy](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/1705911)). When querying products, this field will contain the user provided value. There is currently no way to get back the auto assigned google product categories through the API.|

|maxHandlingTime|string(int64)|false|none|Maximal product handling time (in business days).|
|minEnergyEfficiencyClass|string|false|none|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU. Acceptable values are: - "`A`" - "`A+`" - "`A++`" - "`A+++`" - "`B`" - "`C`" - "`D`" - "`E`" - "`F`" - "`G`" |
|minHandlingTime|string(int64)|false|none|Minimal product handling time (in business days).|

|googleExpirationDate|string|false|none|Date on which the item expires in Google Shopping, in ISO 8601 format.|
|itemLevelIssues|[[ProductStatusItemLevelIssue](#schemaproductstatusitemlevelissue)]|false|none|A list of all issues associated with the product.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#productStatus`"|
|lastUpdateDate|string|false|none|Date on which the item has been last updated, in ISO 8601 format.|
|link|string|false|none|The link to the product.|
|product|[Product](#schemaproduct)|false|none|Product data after applying all the join inputs.|
|productId|string|false|none|The ID of the product for which status is reported.|
|title|string|false|none|The title of the product.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|batchId|integer(uint32)|false|none|An entry ID, unique within the batch request.|
|merchantId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the managing account.|
|method|string|false|none|The method of the batch entry. Acceptable values are: - "`delete`" - "`get`" - "`insert`" |
|product|[Product](#schemaproduct)|false|none|The product to insert. Only required if the method is `insert`.|
|productId|string|false|none|The ID of the product to get or delete. Only defined if the method is `get` or `delete`.|

|---|---|---|---|---|

```json
{
  "promotionAmount": {
    "pretax": {
      "currency": "string",
      "value": "string"
    },
    "tax": {
      "currency": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  },

}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|promotionAmount|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|[required] Amount of the promotion. The values here are the promotion applied to the unit price pretax and to the total of the tax amounts.|
|promotionId|string|false|none|[required] ID of the promotion.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicableShippingLabels|[string]|false|none|A list of shipping labels defining the products to which this rate group applies to. This is a disjunction: only one of the labels has to match for the rate group to apply. May only be empty for the last rate group of a service. Required.|
|carrierRates|[[CarrierRate](#schemacarrierrate)]|false|none|A list of carrier rates that can be referred to by `mainTable` or `singleValue`.|
|mainTable|[Table](#schematable)|false|none|A table defining the rate group, when `singleValue` is not expressive enough. Can only be set if `singleValue` is not set.|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the rate group. Optional. If set has to be unique within shipping service.|
|singleValue|[Value](#schemavalue)|false|none|The value of the rate group (e.g. flat rate $10). Can only be set if `mainTable` and `subtables` are not set.|
|subtables|[[Table](#schematable)]|false|none|A list of subtables referred to by `mainTable`. Can only be set if `mainTable` is set.|

<h2 id="tocS_RefundReason">RefundReason</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarefundreason"></a>
<a id="schema_RefundReason"></a>
<a id="tocSrefundreason"></a>
<a id="tocsrefundreason"></a>

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "reasonCode": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the reason.|
|reasonCode|string|false|none|Code of the refund reason. Acceptable values are: - "`adjustment`" - "`autoPostInternal`" - "`autoPostInvalidBillingAddress`" - "`autoPostNoInventory`" - "`autoPostPriceError`" - "`autoPostUndeliverableShippingAddress`" - "`couponAbuse`" - "`courtesyAdjustment`" - "`customerCanceled`" - "`customerDiscretionaryReturn`" - "`customerInitiatedMerchantCancel`" - "`customerSupportRequested`" - "`deliveredLateByCarrier`" - "`deliveredTooLate`" - "`expiredItem`" - "`failToPushOrderGoogleError`" - "`failToPushOrderMerchantError`" - "`failToPushOrderMerchantFulfillmentError`" - "`failToPushOrderToMerchant`" - "`failToPushOrderToMerchantOutOfStock`" - "`feeAdjustment`" - "`invalidCoupon`" - "`lateShipmentCredit`" - "`malformedShippingAddress`" - "`merchantDidNotShipOnTime`" - "`noInventory`" - "`orderTimeout`" - "`other`" - "`paymentAbuse`" - "`paymentDeclined`" - "`priceAdjustment`" - "`priceError`" - "`productArrivedDamaged`" - "`productNotAsDescribed`" - "`promoReallocation`" - "`qualityNotAsExpected`" - "`returnRefundAbuse`" - "`shippingCostAdjustment`" - "`shippingPriceError`" - "`taxAdjustment`" - "`taxError`" - "`undeliverableShippingAddress`" - "`unsupportedPoBoxAddress`" - "`wrongProductShipped`" |

<h2 id="tocS_ReturnShipment">ReturnShipment</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemareturnshipment"></a>
<a id="schema_ReturnShipment"></a>
<a id="tocSreturnshipment"></a>
<a id="tocsreturnshipment"></a>

```json
{
  "creationDate": "string",
  "deliveryDate": "string",
  "returnMethodType": "string",
  "shipmentId": "string",
  "shipmentTrackingInfos": [
    {
      "carrier": "string",
      "trackingNumber": "string"
    }
  ],
  "shippingDate": "string",
  "state": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|creationDate|string|false|none|The date of creation of the shipment, in ISO 8601 format.|
|deliveryDate|string|false|none|The date of delivery of the shipment, in ISO 8601 format.|
|returnMethodType|string|false|none|Type of the return method. Acceptable values are: - "`byMail`" - "`contactCustomerSupport`" - "`returnless`" |
|shipmentId|string|false|none|Shipment ID generated by Google.|
|shipmentTrackingInfos|[[ShipmentTrackingInfo](#schemashipmenttrackinginfo)]|false|none|Tracking information of the shipment. One return shipment might be handled by several shipping carriers sequentially.|
|shippingDate|string|false|none|The date of shipping of the shipment, in ISO 8601 format.|
|state|string|false|none|State of the shipment. Acceptable values are: - "`completed`" - "`new`" - "`shipped`" - "`undeliverable`" - "`pending`" |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|active|boolean|false|none|A boolean exposing the active status of the shipping service. Required.|
|currency|string|false|none|The CLDR code of the currency to which this service applies. Must match that of the prices in rate groups.|
|deliveryCountry|string|false|none|The CLDR territory code of the country to which the service applies. Required.|
|deliveryTime|[DeliveryTime](#schemadeliverytime)|false|none|Time spent in various aspects from order to the delivery of the product. Required.|
|eligibility|string|false|none|Eligibility for this service. Acceptable values are: - "`All scenarios`" - "`All scenarios except Shopping Actions`" - "`Shopping Actions`" |
|minimumOrderValue|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Minimum order value for this service. If set, indicates that customers will have to spend at least this amount. All prices within a service must have the same currency. Cannot be set together with minimum_order_value_table.|
|minimumOrderValueTable|[MinimumOrderValueTable](#schemaminimumordervaluetable)|false|none|Table of per store minimum order values for the pickup fulfillment type. Cannot be set together with minimum_order_value.|
|name|string|false|none|Free-form name of the service. Must be unique within target account. Required.|
|pickupService|[PickupCarrierService](#schemapickupcarrierservice)|false|none|The carrier-service pair delivering items to collection points. The list of supported pickup services can be retrieved via the `getSupportedPickupServices` method. Required if and only if the service delivery type is `pickup`.|
|rateGroups|[[RateGroup](#schemarategroup)]|false|none|Shipping rate group definitions. Only the last one is allowed to have an empty `applicableShippingLabels`, which means "everything else". The other `applicableShippingLabels` must not overlap.|
|shipmentType|string|false|none|Type of locations this service ships orders to. Acceptable values are: - "`delivery`" - "`pickup`" |

The merchant account's shipping settings. All methods except getsupportedcarriers and getsupportedholidays require the admin role.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the account to which these account shipping settings belong. Ignored upon update, always present in get request responses.|
|postalCodeGroups|[[PostalCodeGroup](#schemapostalcodegroup)]|false|none|A list of postal code groups that can be referred to in `services`. Optional.|
|services|[[Service](#schemaservice)]|false|none|The target account's list of services. Optional.|
|warehouses|[[Warehouse](#schemawarehouse)]|false|none|Optional. A list of warehouses which can be referred to in `services`.|

A batch entry encoding a single non-batch shippingsettings request.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the account for which to get/update account shipping settings.|
|batchId|integer(uint32)|false|none|An entry ID, unique within the batch request.|
|merchantId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the managing account.|
|method|string|false|none|The method of the batch entry. Acceptable values are: - "`get`" - "`update`" |
|shippingSettings|[ShippingSettings](#schemashippingsettings)|false|none|The account shipping settings to update. Only defined if the method is `update`.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer|[TestOrderCustomer](#schematestordercustomer)|false|none|Required. The details of the customer who placed the order.|
|enableOrderinvoices|boolean|false|none|Whether the orderinvoices service should support this order.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#testOrder`"|
|lineItems|[[TestOrderLineItem](#schematestorderlineitem)]|false|none|Required. Line items that are ordered. At least one line item must be provided.|
|notificationMode|string|false|none|Restricted. Do not use.|
|paymentMethod|[TestOrderPaymentMethod](#schematestorderpaymentmethod)|false|none|The details of the payment method.|
|predefinedDeliveryAddress|string|false|none|Required. Identifier of one of the predefined delivery addresses for the delivery. Acceptable values are: - "`dwight`" - "`jim`" - "`pam`" |
|predefinedPickupDetails|string|false|none|Identifier of one of the predefined pickup details. Required for orders containing line items with shipping type `pickup`. Acceptable values are: - "`dwight`" - "`jim`" - "`pam`" |
|promotions|[[OrderLegacyPromotion](#schemaorderlegacypromotion)]|false|none|Deprecated. Ignored if provided.|
|shippingCost|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Required. The price of shipping for all items. Shipping tax is automatically calculated for orders where marketplace facilitator tax laws are applicable. Otherwise, tax settings from Merchant Center are applied. Note that shipping is not taxed in certain states.|
|shippingCostTax|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Deprecated. Ignored if provided.|
|shippingOption|string|false|none|Required. The requested shipping option. Acceptable values are: - "`economy`" - "`expedited`" - "`oneDay`" - "`sameDay`" - "`standard`" - "`twoDay`" |

<h2 id="tocS_Value">Value</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemavalue"></a>
<a id="schema_Value"></a>
<a id="tocSvalue"></a>
<a id="tocsvalue"></a>

```json
{
  "carrierRateName": "string",
  "flatRate": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "noShipping": true,
  "pricePercentage": "string",
  "subtableName": "string"
}
```

The single value of a rate group or the value of a rate group table's cell. Exactly one of `noShipping`, `flatRate`, `pricePercentage`, `carrierRateName`, `subtableName` must be set.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|carrierRateName|string|false|none|The name of a carrier rate referring to a carrier rate defined in the same rate group. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|flatRate|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|A flat rate. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|noShipping|boolean|false|none|If true, then the product can't ship. Must be true when set, can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|pricePercentage|string|false|none|A percentage of the price represented as a number in decimal notation (e.g., `"5.4"`). Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|subtableName|string|false|none|The name of a subtable. Can only be set in table cells (i.e., not for single values), and only if all other fields are not set.|

```json
    ]
```

A fulfillment warehouse, which stores and handles inventory.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|businessDayConfig|[BusinessDayConfig](#schemabusinessdayconfig)|false|none|Business days of the warehouse. If not set, will be Monday to Friday by default.|
|cutoffTime|[WarehouseCutoffTime](#schemawarehousecutofftime)|false|none|Required. The latest time of day that an order can be accepted and begin processing. Later orders will be processed in the next day. The time is based on the warehouse postal code.|
|handlingDays|string(int64)|false|none|Required. The number of days it takes for this warehouse to pack up and ship an item. This is on the warehouse level, but can be overridden on the offer level based on the attributes of an item.|
|name|string|false|none|Required. The name of the warehouse. Must be unique within account.|
|shippingAddress|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|Required. Shipping address of the warehouse.|

|carrierService|string|false|none|Required. Carrier service, such as `"ground"` or `"2 days"`. The list of supported services for a carrier can be retrieved via the `listSupportedCarriers` method. The name of the service must be in the eddSupportedServices list.|
|originAdministrativeArea|string|false|none|Shipping origin's state.|
|originCity|string|false|none|Shipping origin's city.|
|originCountry|string|false|none|Shipping origin's country represented as a [CLDR territory code](http://www.unicode.org/repos/cldr/tags/latest/common/main/en.xml).|
